title: Hapi: A Multivariable Land-Surface Transformer for Medium-Range Hydrological Forecasting at Continental Scale
abstract: arXiv:2609.22702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate flood forecasts several days in advance are essential for flood control, water-resource management, and emergency response. Producing them at high resolution over a continental domain calls for local hydrological detail together with spatial context extending from river basins to synoptic weather systems. We developed Hapi, a U-Net Swin Transformer that uses fine three-dimensional patches and hierarchical shifted-window attention to forecast discharge, surface runoff, snow water equivalent, and soil wetness across the contiguous United States. The model produces 24--72-hour forecasts at $0.05^{\circ}$ resolution, with learned Laplacian task weights adjusting each variable's contribution to training. On 2024 test data using reconstructed weather and land-surface inputs from ERA5-Land, Hapi outperformed an operational physics-based model and a state-of-the-art AI model in flood detection. translated_title: Hapi：用于大陆尺度中期水文预报的多变量陆面Transformer
translated_abstract: 提前数天的准确洪水预报对于防洪、水资源管理和应急响应至关重要。要在大陆范围内以高分辨率生成此类预报，既需要局地水文细节，也需要从流域到天气尺度系统的空间背景信息。我们开发了Hapi，这是一个U-Net Swin Transformer，利用精细的三维patch和分层移位窗口注意力机制，对美国本土的流量、地表径流、雪水当量和土壤湿度进行预报。该模型以0.05°分辨率生成24-72小时的预报，并通过可学习的拉普拉斯任务权重来调整每个变量对训练的贡献。在使用由ERA5-Land重建的天气和陆面输入的2024年测试数据上，Hapi在洪水检测方面优于一个业务化物理模型和一个最先进的AI模型。针对3,881个美国（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: Hapi是一个基于U-Net Swin Transformer的大陆尺度多变量水文预报模型，可在0.05°分辨率下生成24-72小时的流量、地表径流、雪水当量和土壤湿度预报，其洪水检测能力超越了业务化物理模型和最先进的AI模型。
en_tdlr: Hapi is a U-Net Swin Transformer for continental-scale multivariable hydrological forecasting that produces 24-72-hour forecasts of discharge, surface runoff, snow water equivalent, and soil wetness at 0.05° resolution, outperforming both an operational physics-based model and a state-of-the-art AI model in flood detection.
